findings.description: Released screen wake locks are never cleared, so the visibility handler cannot reacquire them.
findings.failure_scenario: A phone backgrounds an active workout and the browser releases its wake lock; returning visible leaves a non-null released sentinel, so the screen may sleep during the run.

findings.description: The wordmark clears an active run without the required confirmation.
findings.failure_scenario: A runner taps the header by accident while running; new-workout discards the active run and result instead of using the confirmed End flow.

findings.description: The final-five-second transition mixes toward the current intensity rather than the next intensity.
findings.failure_scenario: When an Easy interval is about to become MAX, the background continues to cue Easy, so the promised anticipatory visual signal is absent.

findings.description: All three reels spin and stop together instead of stopping sequentially on their generated values.
findings.failure_scenario: After Pull, every reel is replaced at the same reveal instant; the approved sequential Focus, Pattern, Finish stop sequence never occurs.

findings.description: Track primary controls use white text on signal red below the 4.5:1 body-text contrast requirement.
findings.failure_scenario: Small button labels render at roughly 4.1:1, making the primary Pull and Start controls harder to read and violating the project contrast rule.

findings.description: iPadOS devices using the desktop-class user agent do not receive Add to Home Screen guidance.
findings.failure_scenario: An iPad reports Macintosh/MacIntel with touch points, so isIosDevice returns false and hides the only available install guidance.

findings.description: The generator and validator omit the approved typed configuration and safety-rule parameters.
findings.failure_scenario: A registered recipe or safety configuration cannot be supplied through the documented internal interfaces, so extension requires editing generator internals and can silently diverge from validation.

findings.description: The header claims offline readiness before the service worker finishes caching the app shell.
findings.failure_scenario: On a first visit with a slow connection, the runner sees READY OFFLINE and closes the page before caching completes; the next offline launch fails despite the status claim.
